C20 PATCH
=========
Patched file   : ftxui.cpp
Patch date     : 2026-10-31
Marker         : "C20 PATCH BEGIN/END: Windows mouse" (two paired blocks)

  (1) App::Internal: added the last_mouse_button_ member, which remembers the
      last pressed mouse button so a release event (where the console clears
      dwButtonState) still carries the button being released.

  (2) Internal::FetchTerminalEvents: added the _WIN32 MOUSE_EVENT branch that
      converts Win32 console mouse records into FTXUI Mouse events.

Purpose:
  Deliver mouse input when running under conhost, where FTXUI's native
  terminal mouse parser never sees anything because conhost does not emit
  SGR mouse reports. Under Windows Terminal the SGR mouse sequences are handled
  by FTXUI's native parser instead; the two paths are complementary and do not
  overlap.

Notes:
  - Amalgamated layout is available; NO fallback to the source tree was needed.
  - Windows/MSVC requires: /std:c++17 /utf-8 /EHsc /DUNICODE /D_UNICODE /DNOMINMAX
  - Link against threads.
  - Split usage: include "ftxui.hpp" and compile "ftxui.cpp" into the target.
  - Header-only usage: in exactly one .cpp define FTXUI_IMPLEMENTATION before
    #include "ftxui_all.hpp"; other files just #include "ftxui_all.hpp".
  - This is a single self-contained header; there is NO ftxui/... include tree.
